scope: Actual SU(2) Wilson collective local response is controlled by the absolute row sums of its centered likelihood Gram matrix, retaining correlations between input-link changes. For actual row nu_u, s_i(v)=p_(R_i u)(v)/p_u(v)-1 is continuous, has zero mean, and depends on output v only through link e_i. Its Gram G_ij(u)=E_nu_u[s_i*s_j] is symmetric positive semidefinite with proved diagonal bound B(beta,q_i)=(exp(4*beta*norm(q_i-1))-1)^2. For distinct links, G_ij+1=Z(u)*Z(R_i R_j u)/(Z(R_i u)*Z(R_j u)), where Z is the actual row partition function. If their affected spatial plaquette sets are disjoint, the bare spatial action cancels and G_ij=exp(Delta_i Delta_j log g)-1 for the constructed original ground amplitude g. For real amplitudes a_i, a uniform absolute row-sum bound kappa on M_ij=a_i*a_j*G_ij implies sum_i a_i^2 E_i(P f)<=kappa*(Var_pi f-Var_pi(P f)), and the time sum through k steps is at most kappa*(Var_pi f-Var_pi(P^k f)). Gauge-invariant sources use the already proved identification with original normalized physical transfer powers. The upper Gram bound is an explicit hypothesis; its uniform weak-coupling control is not proved. A separate collective whole-slab lower bound then conditionally gives contraction kappa/(1+kappa). No mass gap, continuum limit or surviving physical excitation is inferred. All twelve Clay obligations remain open.

proof.law: The actual temporal-gauge row nu_u and constructed ground law pi=g^2 Haar are unchanged. Physical observables are continuous real gauge-invariant functions.
proof.scores: For rotation q_i at link e_i, s_i(u,v)=p_(R_i u)(v)/p_u(v)-1. Its mean under nu_u is zero. Its output dependence is exactly local to v_(e_i), despite full-law dependence of the normalization.
proof.gram: G_ij(u)=E_nu_u[s_i*s_j], with actual interacting-row expectation. G is symmetric positive semidefinite; 0<=G_ii<=(exp(4*beta*norm(q_i-1))-1)^2.
proof.distinct_link_partition_identity: For e_i!=e_j, G_ij(u)+1=Z(u)*Z(R_i R_j u)/(Z(R_i u)*Z(R_j u)). The pointwise row-weight product factorization preceding integration is proved for the actual kernel, including its output ground amplitude.
proof.bare_action_cancellation: For distinct links with disjoint affected spatial plaquette sets, V(R_i R_j u)+V(u)=V(R_i u)+V(R_j u). The corresponding spatial-weight product identity is proved, including periodic geometries with repeated plaquette occurrences.
proof.mixed_ground_identity: Since Z(u)=lambda*g(u)/spatialWeight(u), the separated Gram entry is exactly G_ij=exp(Delta_i Delta_j log g)-1, where Delta_i Delta_j log g=log g(R_i R_j u)+log g(u)-log g(R_i u)-log g(R_j u). No regular gauge fixing or ground derivative is assumed.
proof.generic_collective_bound: For a continuous real score family s under a compact probability law and absolute Gram row sums<=kappa, sum_i |E[s_i*(f-Ef)]|^2<=kappa*Var(f). The proof expands the Gram quadratic form, bounds it by a symmetric Schur estimate, and applies L2 Cauchy-Schwarz with the response vector itself.
proof.weighted_matrix: For real a_i, M_ij=a_i*a_j*G_ij is the actual Gram matrix of a_i*s_i and is positive semidefinite. The row condition is forall u,i: sum_j |M_ij(u)|<=kappa, with kappa>=0.
proof.stationary_dissipation: The row condition gives sum_i a_i^2 E_i(P_raw f)<=kappa*(Var_pi(f)-Var_pi(P_raw f)). The same coefficient bounds the sum over times j<k by kappa*(Var_pi(f)-Var_pi(P_raw^k f)). There is no additional direction-count or time-count factor in this implication.
proof.physical_identification: For gauge-invariant f the predecessor flow_embedding identifies every iterate used here with original normalized complex Hilbert-space transfer powers under the ground-state embedding.
proof.conditional_slab_payoff: If final variance is bounded above by the accumulated weighted response, then Var_pi(P^k f)<=kappa/(1+kappa)*Var_pi(f). Both the uniform Gram upper bound and this lower response bound are explicit unproved analytic premises.

assumptions: Finite periodic spatial SU(2) lattice n>0 and beta>=0.
A finite family of specified link rotations with arbitrary real amplitudes; repeated links are allowed for the Gram and collective bounds.
Distinct links are required for the mixed partition formula; disjoint affected plaquette sets are additionally required for bare-action cancellation and the mixed ground formula.
The collective upper estimate assumes a uniform absolute row-sum bound on the actual Gram matrix, pointwise in baseline input.
The contraction conclusion separately assumes the displayed whole-slab response lower bound.
comparison_to_predecessor: The preceding coefficient sum_i a_i^2 B(beta,q_i) charges each direction separately. The new sufficient coefficient uses actual cross-correlations through a Gram row norm and can exploit weak correlations; it is not automatically smaller for every matrix, and no uniform row bound for the weak-coupling model is claimed.
not_inferred: Prove a uniformly controlled absolute row sum, or a sufficiently strong substitute quadratic bound, for the actual centered likelihood Gram matrix along a justified physical weak-coupling trajectory. Individual diagonal bounds alone do not control accumulated off-diagonal correlations.

For input links whose affected plaquettes are disjoint, bound the exact mixed ground response exp(Delta_i Delta_j log g)-1 with summable spatial dependence, including control of the remaining nearby pairs. The proved identity does not establish this decay.

The present integrated estimate assumes a pointwise-in-input Gram row bound. A bound only on the ground-law average of the matrix is not a valid replacement: conditional source variance is correlated with that input. Any good-region/bad-region substitute needs a corresponding weighted source estimate.

Prove the separate collective whole-slab lower bound of Var_pi(P^k f) by its accumulated weighted local responses, uniformly for the required physical observables and fixed physical slab. Neither Gram positivity nor its proposed upper bound supplies this coercivity.

Keep kappa uniform in cutoff and spatial volume; replacing a sum of individual constants by an actual Gram row norm does not itself prove volume independence. Correlated large-field clusters, boundary terms and generated interactions remain to be controlled.
Construct a surviving nonzero finite-energy continuum excitation and compatible all-order renormalized bounds on the same independently justified physical beta(a) trajectory.
All twelve full Clay obligations remain open.
